title: Board Evaluation, Director Development and the Oversight Plan
summary: How boards evaluate their own effectiveness and develop their directors, ending with each participant drafting a risk-based oversight plan for their own board.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: How boards evaluate their own effectiveness and develop their directors, ending with each participant drafting a risk-based oversight plan for their own board.
Learning Objectives: Design a proportionate board and director evaluation process
Plan induction, continuing development and succession for the board
Produce a draft risk-based oversight plan for the participant's board
Syllabus: Internal and external evaluations, and tracking actions to completion
Induction, continuing professional development and succession planning
Due diligence before joining a fund board
Workshop: drafting the board's risk-based oversight plan
Intended Audience: Chairs, independent and non-executive directors of investment funds and fund management companies
Executive directors, conducting officers and designated persons who prepare board business
Company secretaries and governance professionals who design and maintain board frameworks
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Current or prospective experience as a fund or management company director is helpful. No prior governance qualification is required.
Core Reading: IOSCO, Examination of Governance for Collective Investment Schemes (2006–2007)
FSB, Enhancing Third-Party Risk Management and Oversight: A Toolkit for Financial Institutions and Financial Authorities (2023)
FSB, Strengthening Governance Frameworks to Mitigate Misconduct Risk: A Toolkit for Firms and Supervisors (2018)
